messages:
tayla: Hey team — started seeing `invalid_api_key` (401) but only when hitting our Dedicated endpoint. Same API key works fine against api.redwood.com. Anyone seen this?

eli: Hmm — can you paste the curl you used (sanitized)? quick check: are you pointing at your dedicated hostname + port or the hosted api?

tayla: Curl I ran (redacted):
```
curl -X POST 'https://dedicated-nyc.mycompany.redwood-internal.com/v1/generate' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hello"}'
```
Response: 401 {"error":"invalid_api_key"} — same sk_live_XXXX succeeds against https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate

marta: Quick notes: hosted (api.redwood.com) keys and Dedicated keys are separate credentials. Hosted sk_live keys won't authenticate against a Dedicated control plane unless you've configured cross-environment provisioning.

eli: If you provisioned Dedicated via our enterprise onboarding, there should be a dedicated key issued for that cluster (starts with `dk_` in most setups) or an org-level mapping. Can you check the Dedicated admin console (or ask your infra lead) for a Dedicated API key?

tayla: Ah — we only grabbed the hosted key from our dashboard. We did deploy Dedicated via the partner onboarding but didn't create a dedicated token. Is there a way to mint one from the hosted account?

marta: Not automatically. Two common fixes: 1) Create a Dedicated API key in the Dedicated control plane (recommended) — UI: Dedicated Console > Access > API keys. 2) If you want hosted keys to work, request a mapping from your Redwood CSM/Onboarding team (we can enable a bridge but it requires account-level config and may be gated).

eli: For immediate repro/fix: create a dedicated key and try again. Example (once you have dk_ key):
```
curl -X POST 'https://dedicated-nyc.mycompany.redwood-internal.com/v1/generate' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dk_YYYY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hi"}'
```
If that still 401s, paste the exact Host header and the full x-request-id from the response and we'll escalate.

tayla: Creating a dk_ key now. Will try & report back. Thanks! :pray:

infra-bot: [automated] Dedicated cluster "dedicated-nyc" health: green. Node pool: 4 gpus.

tayla: Confirmed — new dk_ key succeeds. No more 401s against Dedicated endpoint. Leaving note for infra: need process to provision dk_ for CI/qa.

eli: Great. I'll add a short KB entry: "Hosted keys vs Dedicated keys — common 401" and link to onboarding checklist. If you want, we can open a small automation ticket to provision dk_ to your CI project.

marta: Filing internal task: ORG-4412 - add CI key provisioning step to Dedicated onboarding. Assigning to infra team.

tayla: Awesome — thanks everyone!
